name: karsa-server
description: The Karsa daemon. Serves the HTTP API + web UI, runs the per-project schedulers, and gatekeeps engine subprocesses.

upgrade.note: Upgrading the daemon binary is the one package that needs the running process to re-exec (new daemon code); state lives on disk and rebuilds on boot (spec_01KVE4X4BM2A §6.5 tier 3).
